name: create-ogs-game
description: `pnpm create ogs-game my-game`: a phone-and-TV web game (Cloudflare Worker, one Durable Object per room, actor-kit) plus its own iOS/Android app on the OGS shell (AirPlay and Chromecast), CI and the steps to TestFlight

scripts.vendor: pnpm --dir ../.. --filter "@open-game-system/shell..." --filter "@open-game-system/profile-kit..." --filter "@open-game-system/cast-kit-react..." --filter create-ogs-app run build && node scripts/pack-vendor.mjs
